msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia roda-peinetas-17.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a gold and pearl Valencian jewellery set with earrings, a brooch, hair pins and a pearl necklace on black from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia roda-peinetas-16.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a gold filigree jewellery set with green stones from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia roda-peinetas-19.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a gold and topaz jewellery set with a pearl choker from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
